title.narrative: Renewable Energy Solar and Storage on Efate and Tanna (RESSET), Vanuatu

description.narrative: Support the government of Vanuatu to meet its climate change mitigation objectives by increasing the capacity for solar energy generation and storage on the islands of Efate and Tanna, Vanuatu. This project will reduce the reliance on imported fuel for electricity, reducing emissions and the cost to consumers, while further incentivising the uptake of renewable energy sources.
